name: Beaches of the D-Day Landings, Normandy, 1944
description: Along about 80 km of Normandy's coast, these five landing beaches (Utah, Omaha, Gold, Juno and Sword) and the cliff-top battery at Pointe du Hoc mark where Allied troops stormed ashore on 6 June 1944. You can still walk among German bunkers, gun emplacements and shell-scarred ground, and visit the vast American Cemetery at Colleville-sur-Mer overlooking Omaha.
